caption: The drawing consists of twelve squares arranged in a 4x3 grid on a beige background. Each square contains a different textile or fabric pattern. The patterns in the top row are: a deep red square with small, light-colored floral motifs; a pattern with vertical zigzag brown and black stripes and large pink medallions; a black background with clusters of small lavender and pale purple circles and vines. The second row includes: a reddish-brown background with small pale yellow and red flowers; a vertical striped pattern in shades of red, white, and beige; a solid black background with two red oval shapes featuring smaller white and black inner motifs. The third row displays: a dark brown background with larger cream and pink floral shapes; a blue and white checkered plaid; a series of small, repeated shield-like motifs on a red-orange grid background. The fourth and final row features: a purple square with tiny pink and white floral patterns; a brown and yellow tartan plaid; and a purple field with repeating small horizontal yellow and white stubs. Each square is aligned evenly with margins between them and equal space from the edges of the paper.
title: Printed Cottons
